# SOGI – Solution of Glass & Industries

> SOGI is a Nepali manufacturer of architectural glass hardware and glass fittings (SS304 and SS202 stainless steel), based in Bharatpur, Chitwan, Nepal, with branches in the Kathmandu Valley and Birgunj and online ordering with delivery across Nepal. SOGI also sells toughened, laminated, DGU and fluted glass and mirrors (glass is supplied, not manufactured by SOGI). Its SOGI Projects Division does toughened glass work: glass fitting, fabrication and installation for homes, offices, hotels, shops and interiors across Nepal.

Tagline: देश को गौरव, हाम्रो उत्पादन (Desh ko Gaurav, Hamro Utpadan)

## Glass installation services (SOGI Projects)
- [Glass Partitions & Cabins in Nepal](https://www.sogi.com.np/glass-partition-nepal.html): Frameless and framed partitions, glass cabins and conference rooms that divide space without blocking light.
- [Frameless Glass Doors in Nepal](https://www.sogi.com.np/glass-door-nepal.html): Single, double and sliding toughened glass doors on SOGI floor springs and SS304 patch fittings.
- [Shop Front & Showroom Glass in Nepal](https://www.sogi.com.np/shop-front-glass-nepal.html): Glass fronts behind shutters, frameless shop fronts and tall showroom glazing.
- [Shower Enclosures & Bathroom Glass in Nepal](https://www.sogi.com.np/shower-enclosure-nepal.html): Fixed panels, swing and sliding enclosures and corner cubicles with rust-resistant SS304 hinges.
- [Glass Railings & Balconies in Nepal](https://www.sogi.com.np/glass-railing-nepal.html): Staircase, balcony and terrace railings on SS304 spigots, side studs or base channels.
- [Glass Canopies & Skylights in Nepal](https://www.sogi.com.np/glass-canopy-skylight-nepal.html): Entrance canopies, skylights and glass roofs, always in laminated glass for overhead safety.
- [Spider Glazing & Structural Glass in Nepal](https://www.sogi.com.np/spider-glazing-nepal.html): Point-fixed glass on SS spider fittings for lobbies, showroom fronts and canopies. Facade work on request.
- [Fluted & Decorative Glass in Nepal](https://www.sogi.com.np/decorative-glass-nepal.html): Fluted partitions, back-painted kitchen glass, tinted and frosted design glass, shelves and writing boards.
- [Glass Repair & Replacement in Nepal](https://www.sogi.com.np/glass-repair-nepal.html): Floor spring and patch repair, broken glass replacement, shower hinge fixes and SS304 upgrades.
